What’s ON This Weekend for Families in Toronto & the GTA

The Best Events This Weekend for Kids | September 4-7, 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:16
Instaread

Looking for fun things to do with the kids this weekend? Explore our updated guide to family-friendly events, activities, festivals, and outings happening across Toronto, the GTA and South Central Ontario!

Looking for more family outing ideas? Visit our Family Fun Guides for more events, best places to go and fun activities, across the GTA and Southern Ontario.

FEATURED

Canadian National Exhibition

  • August 21 – September 7, 2026
  • Exhibition Place, 100 Princes’ Blvd, Toronto

The Canadian National Exhibition (CNE) returns to Toronto with rides, games, live entertainment, incredible food and family fun! Explore midway attractions, shopping, exhibits, performances, kids’ activities and annual favourites throughout the grounds. A beloved end-of-summer tradition, the CNE offers something for all ages!
